name: fossa-pr
description: FOSSA issues on a GitHub pull request: list them, tell new from old, then explain, fix, ignore, or hand them to fossabot.

interface.shortDescription: Triage the FOSSA issues on a pull request
interface.longDescription: Lists the FOSSA issues on a GitHub pull request, marks the ones the PR brought in, and fixes, ignores, or hands each one to fossabot. Runs a small local MCP server that uses your FOSSA API key and your gh login.
defaultPrompt: Show the FOSSA issues on this PR
